nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Default Credential Exploitation
nodes.precondition: Network or local access to Raspberry Pi running Raspberry Pi OS (<= 5.10) with unchanged default credentials (pi:raspberry).
nodes.postcondition: Authenticated access to the system with 'pi' user privileges and access to sudo/administrative control.

nodes.label: RaspAP Authentication via Recovered/Default Credentials
nodes.precondition: Network access to RaspAP web interface and knowledge of valid or default credentials.
nodes.postcondition: Authenticated session within RaspAP 2.5 web interface.

nodes.label: RaspAP 2.5 Web Console Remote Code Execution
nodes.precondition: Authenticated session within RaspAP 2.5 with access to includes/webconsole.php.
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary OS command execution, file upload capabilities, and persistent code execution on the underlying Raspberry Pi OS.

nodes.label: piSignage Arbitrary File Download via Path Traversal
nodes.precondition: Network access and authenticated low-privilege account on piSignage player API (version < 2.6.4).
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary file disclosure on the Raspberry Pi host (including configuration files, shadow file, and logs) via api/settings/log?file=../.

nodes.label: Raspberry Pi Glowworm Optical Side-Channel Attack
nodes.precondition: Raspberry Pi 3 B+ or 4 B powering connected audio speakers; optical line-of-sight to the power indicator LED via telescope and electro-optical sensor.
nodes.postcondition: Reconstruction of acoustic speech signals and audio eavesdropping from LED intensity fluctuations without system penetration.

nodes.label: Oculus Browser UI Injection and Code Execution
nodes.precondition: Target user visits a remote malicious web page using Oculus Browser (versions 5.2.7 through 5.7.11).
nodes.postcondition: Arbitrary HTML injection into browser UI, UI spoofing, and unprivileged code execution within the Oculus environment.

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe Hard Link Arbitrary File Write
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged local code execution on Windows host running Oculus Desktop (< 1.44.0.32849).
nodes.postcondition: Privileged arbitrary file write via hard link to log file, leading to full Local Privilege Escalation (SYSTEM).

nodes.label: Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher Handle Leak Privilege Escalation
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged local process execution on Windows host running Oculus Desktop (> 1.39 and < 31.1.0.67.507).
nodes.postcondition: Exposure of privileged process handle to unprivileged process, leading to full Local Privilege Escalation (SYSTEM).

nodes.label: NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU Misconfiguration Exploitation
nodes.precondition: Unprivileged physical access to the NVIDIA Jetson board with connection capabilities via PCI bus.
nodes.postcondition: Direct read/write access to the entire physical system memory space, leading to Denial of Service, code execution, complete privilege escalation, and compromise of integrity and confidentiality.
